subject: Shiny app disconnect due to small instance size, how can I increase it?

messages.author: 081c52997ba1ac91
messages.subject: Shiny app disconnect due to small instance size, how can I increase it?
parts:
Hi everyone,

I have a shiny app runs fine in the local. I tried to deploy it but it was disconnected when the app is trying to load a big dataset. I find no errors in the logs. 

I think it is a memory issue, after reading several similar posts. My question is how can I increase the instance size? 

Thank you!

Here's my app url:  https://lilsummer.shinyapps.io/exer_advisor/

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app disconnect due to small instance size, how can I increase it?
parts:
You can either use the dashboard or rsconnect to configure the settings for your application, including changing the instance type.

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#configuring-your-application
